Table officials

Help us run the scorer's table at our home games. Signing up takes a minute.

Every home game needs people at the scorer's table. There are three seats: the MVP app, the scoreboard and the shot clock. Parents and volunteers are welcome in all three.

Pick a game, pick a seat and write your name. If you can no longer make it, press Remove in the form and type the same name to free the seat.

Open the sign-up in a new window

The form is easier to use in its own window on a phone. Google may show a small grey bar at the top of it. That is normal.
